rulings.restated: Input — Taxable interest from this payer, including Treasury interest and original issue discount (Form 1099-INT boxes 1 and 3; Form 1099-OID boxes 1, 2 and 8, box 2 only when box 11 is blank); exclude tax-exempt interest
rulings.model: Schedule B line 1 says to 'also include any accrued market discount that is includible in income'. Form 1099-OID box 5 reports accrued market discount, and its instructions say 'Market discount on a tax-exempt security is includible in taxable income as interest income.' The restatement's box list (1099-OID boxes 1, 2 and 8) leaves out box 5, and the 1099-INT boxes 1 and 3 it names cannot be checked against the text given.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sb p. 1, Line 1, "Also include any accrued market discount that is includible in income". Market discount (Form 1099-INT box 10, Form 1099-OID box 5) is refused by sb.bond_special, which lists "have market discount to report"; the box list of this input is for the amounts the tool computes. Project stands.
